seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 6px; blocked by bounds, HUD band, wall pixels (rect containing plate centre walkable); first input at counter w=64 is a no-op.
Counter w = 64-(n+1)//2 with hidden action count n (continuity-gated; stateless fallback n=2*(64-w)).
Plate covered by player/ghost -> cable key end retracts 6px toward the column; wall re-rendered with layer-1 body occlusion.
A5 after moving: respawn (14,8), toggle ghost mode; on = record life path, red HUD ring (others x+4), ghost replays path[k-1] after k moves.
Unconfirmed: first-input no-op vs invisible cell at (20,14); constant spawn; ghost/gate collisions unobserved. Names = type_%03d by list order.
